_comment_not_sent_to_aws: Rule 1 prunes untagged layers: three untagged 1.3 GB images were found sitting in
this repo, which is ~$0.39/month billing for images that identify nothing.
Rule 2 replaces an earlier 'keep any 2' rule that would have evicted an immutable
build-* tag within two builds, defeating the point of having one: a result months
old must still be able to name the exact image that produced it.
AWS caps each rule description at 255 characters, so the reasoning lives here.

rules.description: Expire untagged images after 1 day: superseded layers and build garbage that bill for storage while identifying nothing.
Keep the 3 most recent immutable build-* tags so an old result can still name the image that produced it. ~3 x 1.3 GB = about $0.39/month.
